blind_target.authors: Jiang, Y., Costello, P., & He, S.
blind_target.title: Processing of invisible stimuli: Advantage of upright faces and recognizable words in overcoming interocular suppression.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
The sole difference was that we used
the t-value and sample size reported by Jiang et al. (2007) to determine BFr0 (respectively,
5.53 and 10).
blind_target.outcome_quote:
In light of the large BF10 , one could therefore
conclude that there is compelling evidence for a face inversion effect, but of a more modest
magnitude compared with earlier studies (see also Stein et al., 2012).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors support the tested effect; smaller effect magnitude does not change the verdict.
